enclave_pubkey.description: Registered enclave ed25519 pubkey (hex, no 0x). The SOLE config home (the enclave package block carries identity only); k8s-infra pins an independent env copy by design (boot-without-enclave).

feeds.description: QC feed registry, keyed by oracle symbol. The `weights` inside are OFF-CHAIN ONLY: waterx_rule on-chain validates sources/ticker/method/min_sources but has no notion of weights, so a weight change moves the signed price via a parameter no on-chain check can see (waterx-quote-center audit-scope I-16). Review weight changes as a trust-surface change.
